notes.title: Patch 2.23.0 out now! Read on for the Latest Features
notes.notes:
Hello there,

We're excited to bring you an update packed with improvements, optimizations, and bug fixes to enhance your gaming experience. 

We also spent a lot of time on the fine-tuning and implementation of the controller vibration feature. This new addition is designed to give you a more immersive gaming experience, allowing you to feel the action as it unfolds. We hope you enjoy it! Read the notes below to find out what's been updated.

[b]New Features
[/b]
• Implemented controller vibration system
• Support for Xbox, PS5 DualSense, PS4 DualShock, and Switch Pro controllers

[b]Gameplay Enhancements
[/b]
• Reduced GPU performance requirements
• Tweak mailbox avatar for computer
• Tweak email attachment button

[b]Bug Fixes
[/b]
• Fixed various typos and linebreaks
• Fixed sound effect issues
• Fixed a missing sprite on Red Chamber’s monitor
• Fixed a display issue with the opening

Thank you all for your support of OPUS: Echo of Starsong, and we hope you'll add our new title OPUS: Prism Peak to your wishlist to get the fastest notification when it's released!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1947910/OPUS_Prism_Peak/

SIGONO

notes.title: Upcoming update for OPUS: Echo of Starsong + Big Announcement for 2023!
notes.notes:

notes.title: OPUS: Echo of Starsong - Update v1.4.3
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40706572/3989094e48ed3a2a7d969488613be8f01d1ebc45.png[/img]

Hey there everyone!

Over the past 2 weeks since launch, we’ve been flooded with kind words and feedback from you guys, and we paid close attention! So the team has been working nonstop to bring you the best experience possible, here is a list of notable changes up until the most recent update:

[h3]UPDATE v1.4.3
[/h3]

- Trading cards!
- New settings (volume controls, graphics, and fps)
- Cloud save support
- Remote play support
- New Retrace Memories menu (allows you jump to a chapter you’ve finished, available to players who played through the game after the 1.4.3 update)
- New All Memories menu (access everything you’ve collected throughout all your playthroughs)
- Fix issue that locks players out of Asteroid 67
- Fix issue that prevents players from getting the achievement "Doesn't need help"
- Various bug fixes

Thanks again for all your support!

notes.title: OPUS: Echo of Starsong gets a release date&theme song!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!
Ever since we released the demo, we've been hard at work, tweaking every single detail of the game just to make it perfect when it's on your hands. And good news, the end is finally near! Very soon, you will be able to start your journey to the Thousand Peaks!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40706572/56b948419dc2f24aa22e2c7de9c6abfdd1188d35.gif[/img]

To learn a little bit more about our main protagonists, theme song, and of course, the release date...

[u][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1504500/OPUS_Echo_of_Starsong/][h1]👉Watch the Release Date Trailer Now👈[/h1][/url][/u]

"We will find each other, no matter how long it takes."

Exiled by his people, Jun ventures out in search of starsongs to redeem himself. But progress is slow until he saves Eda, a witch who can pick up on the sound of asteroids. However, what appears to be a blessed encounter, will end up becoming a lifelong burden...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40706572/1854ebfa13b517a0ea726d1cc87016daac398140.gif[/img]

Mark your dates and wishlist+follow on Steam, because Echo of Starsong is scheduled to be released on Steam on 9/1/2021! 

🔔 We’ve received lots of useful feedback from OPUS: Echo of Starsong demo. Thank you all! 

To turn these feedback into iteration and polish the game to perfection, we’ll deactivate the demo in 18 hrs. And we hope to bring the best experience when the game launch: )
